block_policy.concrete_output_order: input IR function block order, restricted to entry-reachable blocks
block_policy.unreachable: isolated dominance root; empty frontier; not renamed and omitted from SSA output

deterministic_errors.format: stage-qualified function error; verifier errors are SSA verification failed

dominance.frontier: reachable join blocks only; for each reachable predecessor walk immediate dominators until idom(join)
dominance.immediate_dominator: strict dominator with greatest dominator-set cardinality, ties by later input block index
dominance.reachable_initialization: entry={entry}; other reachable blocks=all reachable; iterate intersection of reachable predecessors

exception_policy.cleanup_blocks: ordinary blocks governed by the same reachability, dominance and phi rules
exception_policy.invoke_values: result is available on normal continuation; exception event is available on exceptional continuation via verifier-governed edge arguments
exception_policy.merge_phis: exceptional and normal predecessors are predecessor-labelled identically; edge kind does not alter phi algorithm
exception_policy.payload_and_lifecycle: preserved/expanded in instruction order before CFG construction
exception_policy.throw_rethrow_propagate: one exceptional successor iff optional target is present; otherwise function exit

instruction_effects.canonical_owner: aether.instruction_effects and effects attributes on aether.ir.model instruction classes
instruction_effects.lowering_specific_storage_owner: PhiPlacement/SSARenamer: only IRStore defines/writes promotable storage and IRLoad reads it
instruction_effects.rule: effect attributes classify preservation/trap/throw/memory/allocation; lowering converts every supported non-load/store instruction in source order; stores push a slot value and loads bind the current stack top; lifecycle pseudo-instructions never reach direct renaming

lifecycle_normalization.ordering: expand_lifecycle runs once at module-builder entry before per-function CFG; emitted instructions retain expansion order
lifecycle_normalization.semantics: type-directed expansion to ordinary loads, stores, constants, aggregate operations and ownership/lifecycle calls; move/relocate consume source lifetime and destroy/rollback use reverse aggregate field order

metadata_preservation.contract: Every field represented by SSA schema-v2 and accepted by the corresponding SSA instruction is copied exactly; absence remains absence
module: ordered nominal struct definitions including ordered fields
required: source_location where the SSA model retains it
function reference and indirect callee/signature types

phi_placement.definite_initialization: forward must analysis: in is intersection of predecessor out sets; out=in union block IRStore definitions; entry/no-predecessor in empty
phi_placement.definition_sites: all blocks containing IRStore for the slot
phi_placement.insertion: iterated dominance frontier; insert only when slot is live-in OR definitely initialized-in
phi_placement.liveness: backward fixed point over IRLoad-before-first-IRStore uses and IRStore kills
phi_placement.operand_order: order predecessors are visited by entry-rooted dominator-tree DFS, children in input block order; operands retain predecessor labels
phi_placement.phi_order: slot name lexicographic within each block; blocks use input order
phi_placement.result_type: unique type collected from every IRLoad/IRStore slot declaration
phi_placement.storage_exclusions: only IRLoad/IRStore storage participates after lifecycle normalization

purity: No mutable global policy state. Input is not mutated; lowering allocates lifecycle-expanded IR and SSA objects.

renaming.parameters: predefine ordered parameters in the value namespace; duplicate names are errors; parameters do not initialize storage slots
renaming.phi_incomings: after converting a block, append current top-of-stack for every successor phi; missing/type-mismatched values are errors
renaming.slot_stack: push phi result and each IRStore source; IRLoad binds current top; pop all pushes in reverse on dominator-tree exit
renaming.traversal: entry-rooted dominator-tree depth-first preorder, children in input block order
renaming.value_binding: non-storage results retain their IR name and type; duplicate SSA definitions and undefined uses are errors

temporary_naming.collision: non-phi duplicate definitions are errors; phi names use the least positive .N suffix not already defined
temporary_naming.phi_preferred: first IRLoad result name for that slot in the phi block, else <block>.<slot>.phi
temporary_naming.result_numbering: no global counter; deterministic least-positive suffix search

verification.postcondition: SSAVerifier verifies the complete module after all functions lower; failure is deterministic error
verification.precondition: caller supplies Rust-authoritatively verified Initial IR; GeneralSSABuilder does not repeat Initial IR verification
